description: Gherkin scenarios for US-901: English keywords and English content, @US/@TC tags, Scenario Outline for the boundaries and @missing-info on whatever depends on missing data.
prompt: Use the bdd-case-generator agent to turn the story input/stories/US-901-signup.md into BDD. There are no active connectors: the Jira comments are copied into the story itself.

checks.description: Valid Gherkin: Feature with @US-901, each scenario with its unique @TC-XXX, Given/When/Then, Examples in the Outlines, and at least 2 scenarios with @missing-info @MI-XX and their comment
The keywords are in English (not Dado/Cuando/Entonces)
The step content is in English
Uses a Scenario Outline with Examples for the username boundaries
Uses the exact text that AC5 defines
patterns: Username must be between 4 and 20 characters

checks.description: The coverage goes through the five criteria
Runs the coverage tables through format_tables.py

rubric: The scenarios are declarative (what the person does, not clicks on elements).
Each scenario tests a single rule.
